description: Cancel a pending invitation so the invite link is no longer valid. The email address can be re-invited at any time. Returns a preview unless confirm=true is set.

confirm.description: Set true to perform the action. Omit or false returns a preview only — nothing is written.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

invite_id.description: Id of the pending invitation to cancel.

name: cancel_invite
